chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Effie McDowell, Clarence Todd and the Jamaica old-timers
summary: Milt mentions a singer from the Hall Johnson Choir who knew Clarence Williams, and Danny mentions Clarence Todd and an open-house family friend.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Corona, as far as I... It's over by LaGuardia Airport, over that way, in that territory. We're over near Queens Boulevard and Jamaica Avenue. And that was Jamaica. There's an old lady out there named... Did you know...? I can't call her name, so I'll let that pass.

She sang in the Howard Johnson Choir. McDowell. Effie(?) McDowell. She used to go with Clarence Williams. A little short, dark lady. She's still there. And I've got her on tape with Perry Bradford. But she's a very shy lady. But she was Clarence Williams' or one of those guys' girlfriend. Who is the one who was a great piano player?
Clarence. He's the one who did all the booking. Bradford played, but not too much. He was a great composer.

She talks about how when she was in the Howard Johnson Choir, Fred Waring came down and heard that choir, and started his... He got his idea from that choir. Yes, she's still there. She's one of the last of the old ladies around there.

There's a man named Todd, Clarence Todd, who was a singer and a composer -- he lives out there. Did you ever check that name, of Clarence Todd? He was from here. His sister was named Camilla Todd; she was a songstress. Right here they've got Joe Gordon, who is from New York. He lived out there. He knew everybody, because he used to go from house to house. He used to hang out with Fats Waller's sons. He used to tell me all the time I'd go to James P. Johnson's house, and they all were welcome in his house. It was an open house. All them people were professional people. That's how he got involved with (?). You'd know Joe Gardner if you see him. He's a little light guy who looked like (?)Gene Michaels(?).
I've been going around through the neighborhood and photographing those homes.
